text:
## Examples  
- `[[policy_customer_identification_v2]]` controls KYC decisions from
2026-03-01 and supersedes `[[policy_customer_identification]]`.
- `[[sop_account_opening_v3]]` implements that policy change; it does not replace
the policy as the governing requirement.
- `[[interest_rate_schedule_2026_03]]` controls SmartSaver rates from its stated
effective date; earlier schedules remain historical evidence.

raw_entities.name: SmartSaver Account
raw_entities.description: A savings product with tiered interest rates controlled by interest rate schedules effective from specified dates. The product's rate structure is governed by versioned rate schedules that supersede earlier versions.
context: [[interest_rate_schedule_2026_03]] controls SmartSaver rates from its stated effective date

raw_entities.name: Policy Customer Identification
raw_entities.description: A governance policy controlling KYC decisions effective from 2026-03-01. Version 2 of this policy supersedes the earlier version and establishes the authoritative requirements for customer identification procedures.

raw_entities.name: Standard Operating Procedure Account Opening
raw_entities.description: Version 3 of the account opening standard operating procedure that implements the updated customer identification policy. This SOP does not replace the governing policy but operationalizes its requirements.
context: it does not replace the policy as the governing requirement

raw_entities.name: Interest Rate Schedule 2026-03
raw_entities.description: A versioned interest rate schedule controlling SmartSaver product rates effective from March 2026. Earlier schedules are retained as historical evidence and are superseded by this schedule for current rate determinations.
context: [[interest_rate_schedule_2026_03]] controls SmartSaver rates from its stated effective date
